original_value: Direct left turns (DLTs) could cause traffic slowdown, delay, stops, and even accidents on intersections, especially on no-median roads. Channelization and signalization can significantly diminish negative impact of DLTs. In China, a total of 56 large and medium-sized cities, including 17 provincial capitals, have adopted vehicle restriction policies due to traffic congestion, vehicle energy conservation and emission reduction, which cause travel inconvenience for citizens. This paper mainly studies signalization and channelization selections at intersections based on an entropy method. Based on the commonly used three evaluation indexes, the number of vehicles, CO emissions and fuel consumption have been added. The entropy evaluation method (EEM) method is innovatively used to objectively calculate the weight of the six indexes, which carry out the optimal traffic volume combinations for intersections of present situation, channelization and signalization. A VISSIM simulation is also used to evaluate the operating status of three conditions. The results show that EEM could help enormously in choosing different methods at a certain intersection. With the EEM, six indexes decrease by 20–70% at most.

result.paraphrase: Direct left turns (DLTs) can lead to traffic slowdowns, delays, stopping, and even accidents at intersections, particularly on roads without medians. Channelization and signalization can greatly reduce the adverse effects of DLTs. In China, vehicle restriction policies have been adopted in 56 large and medium-sized cities, including 17 provincial capitals, because of traffic congestion, vehicle energy conservation, and emission reduction, though they inconvenience citizens’ travel. This paper primarily examines how to choose between signalization and channelization at intersections using an entropy-based method. In addition to the three commonly used evaluation indicators, vehicle count, CO emissions, and fuel consumption are included. The entropy evaluation method (EEM) is innovatively applied to objectively determine the weights of the six indicators and to obtain the optimal traffic volume combinations for intersections under current conditions, channelization, and signalization. A VISSIM simulation is also used to assess the operating conditions of the three scenarios. The results indicate that EEM can greatly assist in selecting different approaches for a given intersection. With EEM, the six indicators decrease by up to 20–70%.
